item.title: [New] Private Access Sensor 2.2.79 for domain controllers: updates now install themselves, the local registry break-glass override is gone, and Kerberos enforcement extends to UDP
[New] Defender for Cloud Apps switches the SaaS accounts integration with Identity inventory on automatically from 15 October
[New] Users can now report a Teams meeting or a single participant as a security concern, and the report lands in the reporting mailbox
[New] Outlook on the web and new Outlook will block .msix and .msixbundle attachments by default from early November, in every OWA mailbox policy
[New] Microsoft cancels general availability of credential scanning in the Purview Data Security Posture Agent
[New] Microsoft cancels just-in-time DLP protection for SharePoint, a roadmap item open since 2023
[New] Purview DLP at the network layer through Entra Internet Access starts rolling out: text, prompts and files inspected in transit
[New] Endpoint DLP coverage of FTP and SFTP transfers starts rolling out
[New] SharePoint Advanced Management gets an Inactive files policy that archives files nobody has opened, by PowerShell first
[New] The Agent 365 Dashboard in Viva Insights gains a registry of every agent and activity data for agents with identities
[New] New private Planner tasks will be stored in Planner instead of the Microsoft To Do store from November, which moves them for retention and eDiscovery
[New] Microsoft clarifies that the standalone onboarding package activates the MDI v3.x sensor in a restricted identity-only mode that still needs Defender for Endpoint cloud connectivity
[New] Defender for Cloud moves Kubernetes misconfiguration recommendations from the container instance to the controller, and Secure Score moves with them
[New] Defender for Storage on-demand malware scanning can now target a single blob, file, container or path prefix
[New] Azure Arc-enabled SCVMM is closed to new customers from October 2026, ahead of its September 2029 retirement
[New] Final reminder: the MemberOf rule operator stops processing on 3 November, and dynamic groups built on it freeze in their last state
[New] Twelve Graph permissions became grantable: write access to provisioning-job synchronization metadata, Sentinel Content Hub packages and tenant-defined custom objects
[Graph: Changed permission] EntraBackup.Read.All
item.description: DisplayText "Read Entra Backup configuration, preview jobs, and snapshots"; Allows the app to read the Entra Backup configuration, list snapshots and jobs, and enumerate the changes of a specific preview job. Endpoint added: GET /directory/recovery/configuration.
